description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Accuracy@1 on geometry problems and tree width. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Two lines are displayed: a blue line with triangle markers representing GPT-4o, and an orange line with square markers representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line begins at approximately 24.4% at a tree width of 1, increases to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, and then declines to 24.4% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line starts at 20.0% at a tree width of 1, increases to 31.1% at a tree width of 5, and then declines to 24.4% at a tree width of 7.
